title: This Giant Heart Can Beat Just Twice a Minute
description: A blue whale's heart weighs nearly 400 pounds and can slow to two beats a minute on a dive. Your heart beats about 70.

scenes.subject: heart
scenes.text: Your heart beats about seventy times a minute.

scenes.subject: whale
scenes.text: This one can beat just twice.

scenes.subject: whale
scenes.text: It belongs to a blue whale,

scenes.subject: whale
scenes.text: and it weighs nearly four hundred pounds,

scenes.subject: people
scenes.text: about as much as two adults.

scenes.subject: whale
scenes.text: With its main blood vessels, it stands roughly two meters tall.

scenes.subject: whale
scenes.text: When the whale dives, its heart slows to two beats a minute to save oxygen.

scenes.subject: whale
scenes.text: Then it surfaces and races to thirty seven, close to its limit.

scenes.subject: whale
scenes.text: The biggest heart on Earth, beating slower than you breathe.

scenes.subject: chest
scenes.text: Now put a hand on your chest...
